name: Generate API Script - Create
purpose: Developer tool in the API Generator. Assembles the full "Create" script for an entity as FileMaker script steps on the clipboard: doc block, loop with Start Transaction, JSON validation and rules, parameters into variables, connect/create the record through DBTransactions::<Entity>Id and ONE, Set Field steps, optional sub-script call, result, Save Transaction Result and End Transaction. This is the template the karbon_kontroller write scripts follow.
calls:
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/257 (step 5)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/460 (step 8)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/266 (step 11)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/274 (step 14)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/279 (step 17)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/281 (step 22)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/477 (step 26)
open_question: Not used by the target, but it documents the shape of every generated kontroller script: validate JSON, lock the record via DBTransactions + ONE, set fields, return {"Id"}. The generated script ends with Exit Script "Get ( ScriptResult ) )", a stray closing bracket.

This is the template the karbon_kontroller edit scripts follow.
